new_learnings.text: Breadth can be strongly positive and still fail the long-entry gate when跌停数量过多; 39家跌停 is enough to keep cash despite 3.03:1 breadth and 3 major indices green.
new_learnings.mechanism: High up/down ratios measure participation, but elevated limit-down counts reveal hidden stress and poor tape quality for fresh momentum entries.

new_learnings.text: The MA-distance anti-chase rule is again doing useful work: several visually strong names such as 广合科技、东材科技、上海新阳、杰普特 are disqualified by overextension, not by weak narratives.
new_learnings.mechanism: Momentum names with excessive distance from MA5/MA10/MA20 have poor reward-to-risk because support is too far away and pullback probability rises.

new_learnings.text: Today the best-looking candidates are in 电池 and resource-related groups, confirming that sector leadership matters more than low valuation or headline quality alone.
new_learnings.mechanism: When capital crowds into a small set of sectors, even good stocks outside those leadership groups struggle to attract follow-through.
